speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: Master Shakespeare? Kettleby. From Somerset House. I have been to Nonsuch and back since Sunday on your company's affairs, and my horse wishes you all at the devil.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am in his debt, and in yours. Go on.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: My lord has had the Mayor's letter told him. I am to give you his answer in his own words, and I decline. I will give you the sense.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: Play on. No letter has gone out to any justice. The lords have other matter before them, with a fleet at sea and the Lord Treasurer in his bed.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: My lord says (and here I soften it) that the Lord Mayor has a ropemaker's conscience in a furred gown, and six weeks left to wear it. He says he has read the Mayor's letter, and that the Mayor writes a very fair hand. He says he answers to one lady, and she likes a play. He says if any justice of Middlesex comes to your door you are to send the man to him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I sat three pews behind that gown on Sunday. It looked durable enough to last the six weeks.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Ask if that is in writing.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: Nothing my lord says is in writing, sir. That is why he is still Lord Chamberlain. Keep your house quiet, open your king on the day, and wear the badge. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you, sir, and your horse.
